newsitem.title: USA: Sears, Roebuck names hardware president.
newsitem.headline: Sears, Roebuck names hardware president.

text.p: Sears, Roebuck and Co said Tuesday it named Gary Crittenden to the newly created position of president of hardware stores.

In his new position, Crittenden, formerly Sears executive vice president of strategy and business development, will head the company's off-the-mall Sears Hardware stores and recently acquired Orchard Supply Hardware stores.

"Sears is committed to an aggressive growth strategy, and we are very pleased with the continued expansion and success of our off-the-mall hardware business," Arthur Martinez, chairman, said in a statement.
Crittenden will report to William Salter, president of Sears Home Stores.
In a related move, Sears said Orchard Supply Hardware President Maynard Jenkins said he has accepted a new position, effective January 24, as chairman and chief executive officer of CSK Auto Inc.
Sears owns and operates more than 2,300 department and specialty stores in the United States, including 180 Sears Hardware stores in 19 states and 65 Orchard Supply Hardware stores in California.
